policies.issuance: Current UTC hour only; system K and database seal I; atomic fresh M3 bundle plus ledger. No standalone-batch conversion. Unique model/T; duplicates return original. T<=K<=creation<=I<=T+15min.
policies.ranking: M3 complete/partial readiness, including negative scores. Composite descending then canonical id ordinal ascending; unique sequential ranks. Retain all three, including all-not-ready.
policies.reference: Binance spot 1h UTC USDT klines. E is first UTC hour strictly after I; reference close ends E. Disclose E-I; not execution or exact issuance-time returns.
policies.outcome: M=E+H; return round18(close(M)/close(E)-1), ToEven. Require all H+1 closed candles including reference. Fraction returns; USDT prices, no USD parity. No interpolation, substitute, fees, funding, slippage, direction flip, compounding or MFE/MAE.
policies.missing: Before M pending; matured gaps/invalid facts incomplete. No expiry. Late first facts may complete later; preserve every distinct evidence state. Conflicts do not auto-resolve. Preserve first completed measurement and append later conflict state.
policies.benchmarks: BTC return over identical E-M. RS ordering uses frozen M3 feature 5: round18((1+asset24h)/(1+btc24h)-1), eligible assets only, descending then ordinal id. Missing issuance inputs never reconstructed later.
policies.aggregation: Explicit issued-time interval, all records. Paired samples require original RS ordering and complete undisputed paths for all three assets. Equal issuance arithmetic means and simple differences; rank means from individually complete eligible rows. Partition model/hash, methodology/hash, horizon, eligible set and original quality composition. Null empty means; disclose counts/exclusions. No independent-sample, predictive or probability claims.
policies.collection: Manual private-use XK commands, no normal-worker acquisition. Inputs last120h, candle end T exclusive, scalar end T+1ms exclusive. Outcome candle windows <=7d, only needed intervals. Existing fixed origins and finite transport budgets.
policies.numeric: Checked decimal operations, each division and completed result rounded18 ToEven. Original prices exact; unsupported outcome arithmetic ranges are incomplete, never zero. Exact integer aggregate reduction rounded18 ToEven; unrepresentable aggregate is null with numeric-range issue and unchanged denominator. Stable ordinal reduction order.
